details.title: Name & description
details.description: What students read on the story list and the level page.
details.nameEmpty: The internal name can't be empty.
details.descriptionHint: On the story card, and on any part's preview card that has no text of its own.
details.internalNameHint: What this admin panel calls the set. Students never see it.
details.iconHint: The icon shows on the card only while there is no card image. Level and ID are fixed once a set exists.

cover.title: Card image
cover.description: The picture on this set's card in the story list. Saved as soon as you pick it.
cover.badType: That isn't an image this card can use. Pick a JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF.
cover.heavy: That file is {{size}}. It works, but the covers that ship with the app are around 50 KB, so consider shrinking it.
cover.confirmRemove: Remove the card image? The card goes back to the built-in artwork or the placeholder.
cover.caption: As it appears in the story list
cover.spec: Portrait 4:5 (for example 480 × 600), around 50 KB. JPG, PNG or WebP.
cover.fallback: Without an image the card shows this story's built-in artwork if it has one, or a placeholder.

cast.title: Cast
cast.description: The row of faces under the title on the level page. Each character stays a silhouette until the student reaches the part they first appear in.
cast.badKey: Character {{n}}: the key must be lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
cast.dupKey: Character {{n}}: the key "{{key}}" is already used.
cast.portraitNeedsKey: Give the character a name (or a key) before uploading a portrait — the key names the file.
cast.portraitUploaded: Portrait uploaded — save the cast to put it on the page.
cast.draftNote: Draft — students don't see the cast yet.
cast.name: Name
cast.portraitHint: Without a portrait the first letter is shown.
cast.keyHint: Used in the portrait's file name. Follows the English name until you change it.

access.title: Access & pricing
access.description: Whether the set is in the subscription, and how much of it plays for free.
access.freeCountInvalid: Type how many parts are free (a whole number, 0 or more).
access.freeCountTooMany_one: This set has {{count}} part, so at most {{count}} can be free.
access.freeCountTooMany_other: This set has {{count}} parts, so at most {{count}} can be free.
access.previewInvalid: Type the preview length in whole seconds.

summary.allFree_one: Everyone hears the only part for free. The set is in no subscription.
summary.allFree_other: Everyone hears all {{count}} parts for free. The set is in no subscription.
summary.freeRange: Without a subscription, parts {{from}}–{{to}} play in full.
summary.freeOne: Without a subscription, part {{n}} plays in full.
summary.freeNone: Without a subscription, nothing plays in full.
summary.everyPartFree: Every part is free, so the subscription adds nothing here.
summary.preview_one: Part 1 stops after {{count}} second for anyone without access.
summary.preview_other: Part 1 stops after {{count}} seconds for anyone without access.
summary.onSale: Sold in its level's subscription and the all-levels one.
summary.comingSoon: Shown as “coming soon”, not on sale yet.
summary.takesEffect: Takes effect when the set is published.

access.subscribersHint: Part of the level's subscription and the all-levels one.
access.everyoneHint: Every part free to everyone. In no subscription.
access.soonHint: Until the audio is uploaded. A level with nothing on sale isn't sold.
access.mainCharacterHint: Lowercase, one word. Names the level in the shop.

delete.title: Delete set
delete.description: Removes the set and all {{parts}} for good. Unpublish it instead if you only want to hide it.
delete.confirm: Delete «{{name}}» and all {{parts}}? This can't be undone.
